_why.TRAIL_SHOULDER_W: 8 px shoulders leave dark ground between the inner-ring corridors at phone size; strobe within 0.0001
_why.TRAIL_ALPHA: 0.44 lets the MetroBus yellow and tram red read as lines and cuts strobe 0.0006; lines stay thin, no white
_why.TRAIL_LAYER_ALPHA: 0.8 cuts strobe from 0.0126 to 0.0113 and the lines read in their legend colours; widths unchanged, no white
_why.day.BUS_CORE_R: 1.2 px dots are small sharp points on thin coloured lines and take strobe under the limit, 0.0062 to 0.0038
_why.TIME_WARP_GAMMA: 1.5 lingers on the busy day, so peak dots move less per frame: strobe 0.0038 to 0.0036; night buses still get frames
_why.OUTSIDE_DIM: 0.75 quiets the Potsdam buses and Brandenburg roads past the line, so the Berlin shape reads at phone size
_why.day.TRAIL_MINUTES: 40 min cuts strobe 0.0032 to 0.0028; the corridors stay separate thin coloured lines, whiteout 0.0035
_why.rush.FRAME_ZOOM: 0.81 lifts safe_share 0.84 to 0.88, clears the clock off the south lines and Köpenick off the button column
_why.rush.BUS_CORE_R: 1.2 px dots are the target's small sharp points on thin lines and cut close-up strobe 0.0053 to 0.0035
_why.rush.TRAIL_MINUTES: at 0.81, 32 min cuts close-up strobe 0.0025 to 0.0022; corridors stay thin coloured lines, whiteout 0.0031
